NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 7 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 20, 11:53 PM ET

The Texans are the top-projected defense on the Week 7 DraftKings main slate at 8.2 DraftKings points for $3,400, against the Giants. Vikings (7.1, $3,500) and Broncos (7.1, $3,300) are next.

The Texans are also the top value at the position: 2.42 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 20, 11:53 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 7

Texans, HOU vs NYG ($3,400)

Texans carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 8.2 DraftKings points at $3,400. That is 1.1 points clear of Vikings. The salary works out to 2.42 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 7 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Texans averaged 8.3 points with a simulated floor of -0.4 and a ceiling of 15.6, and it holds 5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Houston is a 9.5-point favorite at home against the Giants, with an implied team total of 26 in a game totaled at 42.5.

Value: Titans, TEN vs CLE ($2,600)

Titans projects for 6.3 DraftKings points at $2,600, which works out to 2.41 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 7 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 10,000 simulations Titans averaged 6.3 points with a simulated floor of -0.1 and a ceiling of 16.2, and it holds 5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Tennessee is a 1.5-point underdog at home against Cleveland, with an implied team total of 18.5 in a game totaled at 38.5.
